title: The AI video of Elon Musk that his own followers couldn't agree was fake
title_candidates: An AI just cloned Elon Musk on video, and the result confused his own followers
Grok Imagine built a fake Elon Musk on video and the comments can barely tell
How Grok's AI generates a photorealistic Elon Musk from a prompt alone
The AI video of Elon Musk that his own followers couldn't agree was fake
What happens when you ask Grok's AI to clone Elon Musk on video
caption:
Grok's AI just generated a near-perfect clone of Elon Musk on video, and the comments couldn't agree on what was real.

Grok Imagine is the AI image and video tool built into X. It now produces photorealistic likenesses of real people with enough detail to pass a quick scroll. Elon shared the clip himself, which made the comment section even harder to read.

This is where AI-generated video sits right now. The distance between real footage and a generated one is shrinking in ways most people haven't seen yet.
